2027 Vanquish VQ115 Veloce for Sale: Cutting-Edge Motor Yacht

Experience the Future of Yachting with the Vanquish VQ115 Veloce

The 2027 Vanquish VQ115 Veloce is a remarkable motor yacht that embodies innovation, performance, and style. Designed for those who seek adventure on the water, this vessel is equipped to handle eco-friendly activities and fishing excursions, making it the perfect companion for your next journey.

Available for sale Worldwide, this new model offers a unique opportunity to own a state-of-the-art yacht that combines advanced engineering with sleek aesthetics.

Exceptional Performance and Engineering
Powerful MTU Rolls Royce Engines

The VQ115 Veloce is powered by three MTU Rolls Royce V16 engines, each delivering an impressive 2,600 HP. This powerful configuration allows the yacht to reach a top speed of 35 knots, ensuring exhilarating performance on the water.

Innovative Surface Drive Technology

Featuring advanced surface drive technology, the VQ115 Veloce provides enhanced maneuverability and fuel efficiency, making it ideal for both high-speed cruising and leisurely outings.

Spacious Accommodations and Comfort
Thoughtfully Designed Living Spaces

The yacht offers comfortable accommodations with a total of 3 berths and 2 heads, ensuring ample space for relaxation and privacy. The well-appointed cabin includes:

  • 1 double bed and 1 single bed
  • 1 shower wet head and 1 shower dry head

This layout is perfect for hosting guests or enjoying a peaceful retreat after a day of adventure.

Equipped for Seamless Operation

The VQ115 Veloce comes with a suite of advanced electronics to enhance your navigation experience:

These features ensure safe and efficient cruising, allowing you to focus on enjoying your time on the water.
